summary: Daily news cards stack up beside the speaker, then the frame floods with falling ink drops as the speech's downpour-of-information metaphor, ending on the words BİLGİ YAĞIŞI over a small figure.

scenes.visual: Right column, vertically centred beside the speaker: three small newspaper pictogram cards (teal blocks with a red halftone masthead bar) print onto the paper one by one at 0.3 s, 0.7 s and 1.0 s, each teal layer landing a few pixels off its red layer, stacking top to bottom; a mustard dot ticks under the stack with each card. End state: a three-card stack, headline HER GÜN YENİ HABER printed above it in two offset inks.

Full frame on new paper: a flat pictogram figure (mustard circle head, teal rounded-rectangle body) stands bottom centre; teal and red ink drops fall from the top edge at growing density, each landing with a small splatter and building a coarse halftone puddle along the bottom edge; the registration wobbles on the heaviest hits around 3.0 s; at 4.9 s the words BİLGİ YAĞIŞI print across the top in two offset inks with YAĞIŞI overprinting in red. End state: continuous downpour over the small figure, puddle a third full.
scenes.camera: slow tilt down with the falling drops, then hold on the figure
